body:
Fenwick d'Jorasco founded Vital Chain, an institution associated with healing, community, connectedness and spiritual restoration in Eovar Harbor.

Recognition in Eovar’s renewal

On 27 January 2025, Ada identifies Fenwick as a halfling wizard, healer, civic rebuilder and Vital Chain’s founder. Her account remembers his part in Eovar’s renewal; it does not date the institution’s founding.

Vital Chain is distinct from Fenwick’s attempted adventurers’ guild and the Ale-Chemy Knights. Their shared concern with support and coordination does not establish a merger. The Chain’s complete membership, governance and later activity remain open.

15 January 2025 · a proposal before the public reputation

Fenwick shares a draft for Vital Chain with Lionel, describing coordinated medical treatment, public health and community readiness in Eovar and Pristinia. He wants a network joining adventurers, neighbors, merchants and craftspeople. The draft already calls him its founder, while his accompanying speech still speaks of creating the group.

Later in the exchange he speaks conditionally about opening in Eovar and then Pristinia. This establishes a named proposal and a developing organization before Ada’s 27 January account. It does not date a legal foundation, confirm two functioning branches or demonstrate that every promised service was delivered.
